course.name: Medicine MBChB
course.notes: Five-year standard-entry Medicine course starting September 2027. Graduates may apply to A100 but complete the same five-year programme; Aston does not offer an accelerated graduate-entry route. The target page contains stale cycle wording, but the supplied official/FOI package confirms the implemented 2026-2027 rules.

medical_school.name: Aston Medical School
medical_school.notes: Official Aston and FOI evidence is used for eligibility, pre-interview scoring, MMI, offer selection and historical guidance.

applicant_pools.notes: Excludes applicants assigned to the WP pool. Ranked by the confirmed /36 formula without cross-pool normalisation. No live fixed boundary is implemented.

applicant_pools.selection_relevance: Applicant cohort descriptor only; no additional ranking pool, scoring rule or admissions decision is inferred.

overall_policy.description: Applicants must meet the minimum requirements for an officially published qualification route, submit a complete UCAS application, take UCAT or UCATSEN in the same year as application and satisfy fitness-to-practise requirements. Eligibility is executable only for the published routes represented below; incomplete routes require manual review.
not_eligible_if: The applicable published academic minimum requirements are not met.
UCAT or UCATSEN is not taken in the same year as the application.
The applicant is currently or was previously enrolled on a Medicine course.
The applicant withdrew from any degree.
The applicant seeks transfer from another degree.
The applicant is currently studying a degree but is not in its final year.
The applicant was previously rejected by Aston because of one or more MMI red flags.
A required complete application, suitable reference or fitness-to-practise requirement is not satisfied.
overall_policy.notes: A-level predicted grades are required where the qualification is in progress but are not scored. Predicted degree classification is considered for final-year degree applicants.

grade_requirements.notes: An achieved approved English-language test may require manual assessment under the separate English-language policy.

accepted_equivalencies: International qualification equivalence confirmed by Aston Admissions
gcse.sitting_policy: GCSE resits are accepted subject to the overall resit timeframe.
gcse.achieved_or_predicted: Achieved GCSE results are used for scoring.

counted_subjects: Double Science as two subjects, or separate Chemistry and Biology
scoring_models.used_for: Home non-WP and Home WP pre-interview ranking.
scoring_models.notes: This current GCSE-only model supersedes the older achieved-A-level and graduate route-specific pre-interview scoring interpretations. Numeric grades 9 to 5 are executable once the selection consumer is updated. The supplied evidence ambiguously maps legacy letter grade A to more than one point value, so legacy A scoring requires manual clarification.

gcse.notes: The minimum gate and current GCSE-only academic score are official. Country-specific GCSE equivalences and ambiguous legacy letter-grade A scoring remain manual Admissions decisions.

national_5.notes: Aston Scottish applicants require at least six National 5 qualifications at grade B or above, including English, Mathematics, and either Chemistry plus Biology or an accepted Combined/Double Science double-award equivalent at B/B.

presentation_offer_routes.explanation: You are eligible for Aston's contextual offer. AA must be in Chemistry and Biology. You must still meet all required subject and GCSE requirements.
presentation_offer_routes.notes: Result Card presentation-only wording. This does not alter the executable Aston A-level eligibility grade profile or subject rules.

grade_requirements.a_star_subject_rule: The A* must be in Chemistry or Biology.
grade_requirements.notes: Where more than three A levels are taken, Chemistry, Biology and the next best grade are considered.

grade_requirements.required_subject_grade_rule: Chemistry and Biology must both be grade A.
grade_requirements.notes: Execution requires manual confirmation that the applicant meets the applicable WP criteria for 2027.

grade_requirements.required_subject_grade_rule: At least one of Chemistry or Biology must be grade A.
grade_requirements.notes: The standard GCSE minimum also applies.

standard_offer.notes: Chemistry and Biology required, with the A* in either.

contextual_offer.notes: AA required in Chemistry and Biology.

a_level.third_subject_rules: Any third subject except General Studies or Critical Thinking.
a_level.practical_requirement: Pass the practical elements where available.

scoring.notes: A-level grades remain eligibility requirements but are not a component of the confirmed current Home/WP pre-interview score.

a_level.notes: Predicted A-level grades are required when qualifications are in progress but are not used in scoring or selection.

grade_requirements.grade_7_subject_rule: The grade 7 must be in Chemistry or Biology.

achieved_non_resit_scoring.notes: IB Higher Level grades remain eligibility requirements but are not a component of the confirmed current Home/WP pre-interview score.

contextual_policy.notes: Confirmed 2027 WP IB requirement: 35 overall with Higher Level 6, 6, 5 including Chemistry and Biology.

ib.notes: Standard and WP IB eligibility are officially evidenced. WP IB remains manual until the eligibility consumer is updated for the 35-point rule.

higher_offer.notes: Step 2 did not validate a standalone Aston Higher pathway comparable with Scottish medical schools. ApplySmart must not infer S5/S6 Higher timing, one-sitting or grade-profile rules.

contextual_advanced_higher_offer.notes: Aston publishes the reduced Aston Ready offer for A-levels. Step 2 did not identify a published reduced Scottish Advanced Higher offer, so ApplySmart must not derive AAB or another contextual Scottish profile.

grade_requirements.notes: Executable Aston Scottish route requires Scottish Advanced Highers AAA including Chemistry and Biology, alongside the shared National 5 requirements.

scottish.notes: Standard Scottish route is executable as six National 5s at grade B or above including required English, Mathematics and science evidence, plus Advanced Highers AAA including Chemistry and Biology. Standalone Higher profile/timing and any contextual Scottish academic reduction remain unresolved and must not be inferred.

accepted_combinations.btec_qualification: BTEC National Extended Diploma in Applied Science
accepted_combinations.notes: Only this exact published combination is supported automatically. Other BTEC combinations require manual review.

btec.notes: Unlisted BTEC combinations are not inferred.

t_level.notes: T Levels are not accepted for MBChB. Applicants presenting a mixed T Level/A-level profile are directed to Admissions for individual advice.

access_to_he.notes: Aston does not currently accept Access courses for MBChB.

degree.accepted_degree_scope: Any discipline from a UK ENIC-recognised university.
degree.application_timing: The degree must be completed or the applicant must be in its final year.
degree.school_qualification_requirement: ABB at A level including Chemistry and Biology, with grade A in at least one, plus the standard GCSE minimum.

scoring.notes: The degree and A-level requirements remain eligibility gates. The older route-specific graduate points model must not replace the confirmed current GCSE-only pre-interview academic score.

degree.notes: A100 is not an accelerated graduate-entry programme.

foundation_programmes.notes: Only Aston's own Healthcare Foundation Year is accepted. External foundation years are not accepted.

published_routes.a_star_subject_rule: The A* must be in Chemistry or Biology.

published_routes.grade_7_subject_rule: The grade 7 must be in Chemistry or Biology.

international_qualifications.notes: Only the named routes are structured. All unlisted international qualifications require Aston Admissions and UK ENIC review.

post_16.notes: Eligibility remains automatic only where the existing evaluator supports every applicable published rule. The standard Scottish route is executable for the validated National 5 plus Advanced Higher AAA including Chemistry and Biology requirements. Any Scottish contextual reduction, WP IB, Aston Foundation and named international routes remain manual until consumer support and official evidence are complete.

ucat.validity_window: UCAT or UCATSEN must be taken in the same year as the application.
ucat.current_cutoff_policy: No fixed UCAT score requirement or lower cutoff is published; the effective rank boundary is dynamic and unknown.

below_1650.notes: The supplied table states only that this is below seven points. No exact value is inferred.

ucat.notes: For Home and WP applicants, the cognitive total is converted to a maximum of 12 points for the confirmed /36 pre-interview score. International applicants remain ranked by raw cognitive total only after academic eligibility. No current cutoff is fixed.

sjt.notes: SJT banding is not scored or considered in ranking, and no lower SJT cutoff is published. Band 4 is therefore not an automatic rejection.

conditions: GCSEs, A levels and accepted equivalent qualifications may be resat, with or without repeating an academic year.
The final qualification profile must normally be achieved within no more than three academic years, allowing one resit-year attempt.
The one-attempt restriction applies to the resit year or attempt cycle, not to a single resat subject; Aston does not publish a one-subject cap.
Applicants resitting A levels or equivalent examinations such as IB are scored on GCSEs only.
Extenuating circumstances are not considered in scoring and ranking.

repeat_application_policy.rejected_pre_interview: May reapply in the next application cycle.
repeat_application_policy.rejected_post_interview: Must wait one full application cycle before reapplying.
repeat_application_policy.mmi_red_flag_rule: Applicants previously rejected because of one or more MMI red flags are excluded.

resits.notes: The published resit limit is one resit-year attempt within no more than three academic years, not one subject. Non-standard sequencing remains manual. Repeat-application limits are now evidenced but require consumer support before automatic decisions.

accepted_tests.validity: Taken within two years of the course start date.

alternative_tests.notes: Alternative English-language tests are not automatically accepted or rejected because complete Medicine-specific equivalences are not encoded.

exemptions.notes: English-language exemptions require individual confirmation and must not be automatically rejected.

lower_gcse_english_equivalence.notes: The medical-school scoring FAQ maps some lower IELTS components to GCSE grades, but the current university eligibility requirement is 7.0 overall and in every component. The scoring table must not reduce eligibility.

english_language.notes: IELTS Academic below the published 7.0 overall and per-component minimum is not eligible. Applicants presenting another English test or claiming an exemption are routed to manual review rather than rejected automatically.

initial_deferred_application.application_method: Apply for deferred entry through UCAS.

application_year_requirements: Interview must be completed in the year of application.
UCAT must be taken in the year of application.
Academic qualifications and all other offer conditions must be obtained in the year of application.
pre_entry_repeat_checks: Occupational-health checks must be repeated before deferred entry.
DBS or applicable police checks must be repeated before deferred entry.
deferred_entry.notes: Deferred entry and gap years are officially permitted. A deferral requested after an offer is not automatically approved and requires manual Aston review.

age_or_professional_checks.notes: Successful applicants must satisfy fitness-to-practise, Enhanced DBS or international police checks and occupational-health requirements.

personal_statement.use: Read with the reference to confirm a suitable academic reference and identify fitness-to-practise or other concerns.

non_academic.reference_policy: Normally supplied by the current or most recent academic institution, or by a current employer when an academic reference is not possible after more than five years out of education.
non_academic.notes: Do not create a work-experience score or other non-academic pre-interview points.

ranking_factors.notes: Six-best-GCSE academic score, including the mandatory subjects, out of 24.
UCAT cognitive total is converted to points out of 12. Exact points below 1650 are unknown.
International applicants who pass academic eligibility are ranked by UCAT cognitive total only.

score_components.notes: Applicants below 1650 require manual or conservative low-band handling because exact points are not supplied.
Applies only to academically eligible International applicants.

total_score.notes: The formula is evidenced but remains non-executable until the selection consumer and acceptance tests support the GCSE component and UCAT band lookup. International selection remains raw UCAT-only.

calculation.notes: Formula evidence is complete for Home and WP. Consumer acceptance and band configuration are confirmed. Interview guidance is active for Home non-WP, Home WP and International pools.

thresholds.international_metric_safeguard: International historical /36 labels are context only; do not calculate an International combined score.
thresholds.notes: No historical or guidance value is a live current cutoff.

selection_adjustments.notes: 2027 WP criteria are evidenced; pool assignment remains dependent on confirmed applicant evidence.
The confirmed current academic component is GCSE-only for Home/WP ranking.

output_band_policy.notes: Interview-band configuration is active. Consumer acceptance confirmed by passing acceptance test suite. Three guidance pools are configured: home_non_wp, home_wp, international.

stage_2_interview_selection.notes: Home non-WP and Home WP use the verified /36 GCSE-plus-UCAT formula in separate lists without cross-pool normalisation. International remains a separate raw-UCAT list after eligibility because the official UCAT-only rule conflicts with historical FOI /36 labels. Formula execution, bands and prediction output remain disabled pending consumer/config acceptance.

criteria.description: Eligible for Free School Meals by the end of Key Stage 4 within the previous six years.
Declared a disability on the UCAS application.
Completed an Aston Pathways programme during Year 12 or Year 13.
Attends Aston University Engineering Academy, Aston University Maths School or Aston University Goldsmith's Institute.
Spent time in local-authority care or is declared as a care leaver.
Granted refugee status by the Home Office.
Lives in a POLAR4 Quintile 1 or Quintile 2 area.

criterion_scope_exclusions: Applicants in the final year of a degree
Applicants who already hold a degree
Applicants who attended an independent school
contextual_admissions.criterion_scope_notes: State grammar school applicants remain eligible for consideration. One evidenced criterion is sufficient, subject to applicant evidence and consumer support.

adjustments.policy_description: The contextual A-level requirement is AAB with AA in Chemistry and Biology.
adjustments.notes: A-level grades remain an eligibility requirement and are not added to the confirmed current GCSE-only academic score.

adjustments.policy_description: Eligible WP applicants are ranked separately from Home non-WP and International applicants.
adjustments.notes: No fixed WP quota is implemented.

wp_place_aim.description: Aston reports 110 Home places and an aim of up to 44 WP offers.

contextual_admissions.notes: The 2027 criteria, AAB adjustment, WP IB 35/665 rule and separate WP pool are evidenced. No fixed quota is inferred; consumer activation remains pending.

quotas.name: Verified Home/International places (2027 entry)
quotas.notes: Home/International place figures verified by the ApplySmart admissions research team for 2027 entry.

interview_format.timing: Normally December to March in the application year.
interview_format.station_mechanics: Several stations assess different attributes; some may use actors or a scenario to read and discuss.

interview_attributes: awareness of limitations and when to ask for help

interview_scoring.notes: Performance across 8 to 10 stations is combined into a raw total out of 45. The station rubric is not encoded.

offer_model.component_scaling: Use the officially supplied academic, UCAT and MMI components in the confirmed 2:1:1 weighting. Only the MMI raw-to-/36 scaling is explicitly supplied; do not invent further precision rules.
offer_model.notes: The MMI scaling rounding convention is not supplied. Boundary cases remain conservative/manual, and no offer prediction is emitted.

official_process_conflict.summary_process: The admissions-process summary says interviewees are re-ranked by total MMI score and top-ranking applicants receive offers within separate Home, WP and International groups.
official_process_conflict.detailed_scoring_process: The detailed scoring section says offers are based on academic, UCAT and MMI scores.

waiting_list_policy.method: Applicants below the group offer threshold are ranked on a reserve list which is activated if offers are declined.

standard_offer.notes: Chemistry and Biology required, with the A* in either.

contextual_offer.notes: AA required in Chemistry and Biology; WP status requires manual confirmation.

non_score_conditions: Satisfactory Enhanced DBS check or international police check
offer_selection.notes: The verified formula, tie-breakers and reserve-list rules are recorded as non-executable production evidence. Historical thresholds are guidance only. Offer prediction remains disabled until consumer and acceptance support exists.

pre_interview_thresholds.notes: Converted values are preserved exactly as supplied. Some early-cycle converted maxima are lower than supplied averages; those extrema must not be repaired or used automatically. International /36 labels do not override the official UCAT-only model.

cycles.notes: Official 2025 descriptive distributions only. Aston states that these values do not guarantee or predict future outcomes. Observed minima are not cutoffs, the /3600 UCAT values must not be compared directly with the current /2700 total, and the 50/10 MMI values do not establish a current five-station format.

historical_admissions.notes: Historical figures are stored for transparent, group-specific guidance only. No value is a fixed current cutoff. The legacy 2025 FAQ distributions remain descriptive; the supplied /2700 conversions are preserved as supplied, and inconsistent extrema are excluded from automatic band derivation.
